ArchivedTask.description: A task that has left the queue, either shipped or deliberately dropped.

completed.description: The instant it left the queue, as `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`.

disposition.description: Whether the work shipped or was dropped.

evidence.description: Where to look to see that it is true.

id.description: The id it held on the queue, never reused after this.

links.description: Anything outside this repository worth following.

notes.description: What a later reader will want to know and cannot reconstruct.

patch.description: The changeset that carried its release note.

plan.description: The plan it was worked from, if it had one.

title.description: What the task was, in one line.

Disposition.description: How a task left the queue.

oneOf.description: The task was abandoned on purpose, and the row says why.

HorizonTask.description: Work that is mapped but has no place on the queue yet.

id.description: Its id, drawn from the same sequence as the queue's.

kind.description: Why it is not on the queue.

links.description: Anything outside this repository worth following.

notes.description: Context a reader needs and the row cannot carry in its other fields.

open.description:
The missing start condition, or the question that keeps it off the
queue.

outcome.description: What would be true once it is done.

patch.description: The changeset it would carry its release note in.

plan.description: A plan document in this repository, when it already has one.

title.description: What it is, in one line.

Kind.description: Why a task sits on the horizon instead of the queue.

oneOf.description: The options are known, but nothing says when to choose.
The start condition is explicit and not met.

acceptance.description: What has to be demonstrably true to close it.

blocked_by.description: Ids that must ship first. Each has to sit earlier in this queue.

id.description: This task's id, unique for the life of the repository.

links.description: Anything outside this repository worth following.

notes.description: Context a reader needs and the row cannot carry in its other fields.

outcome.description: What is true once this is done.

patch.description: The changeset that will carry this task's release note.

plan.description: A plan document in this repository, when the task needs one.

title.description: What the task is, in one line.

active.description:
The one task currently being executed, or null when work is
intentionally paused.

archive.description:
Completed or deliberately dropped work, newest first. Archived ids are
never reused.

horizon.description:
Mapped work that is not on the short-term queue: research, evaluations,
or deferred items without a start condition. File order is not
priority, and `active` must never name a horizon id.

prefix.description: Stable id prefix for this repository. Never encodes priority.

queue.description: Pending work in priority order. The order is the priority.

schema_version.description:
Ledger schema version, the one this qctl writes and accepts. Increment
only with a coordinated schema and ledger migration.
